name: harbor-agw-poc-tooling
description: Repo-level static analysis. Deliberately NOT an npm workspace: each MCP package keeps its own package-lock.json, because the pods install from it with `npm ci` at start-up and workspaces would hoist the lockfile to the root where they cannot find it.

scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix mcp-openapi run typecheck && npm --prefix mcp-harbor run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run knip && npm test
